verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: koTin koTaan dhiaan dhirasaT dharas mil at asacharaj mai herat hiraae hai ||

en.bdb: The wondrous and marvellous state that befalls upon a Sikh of the True Guru when he integrates his vision in that of the Lord, defeats millions of other contemplations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: koTin koTaan giaan sabadh surat mil mahimaa mahaatam na alakh lakhaae hai ||

en.bdb: The importance of union of Guru's words in the consciousness of a Guru-devoted Sikh is beyond comprehension. That glory and grandeur cannot be reached by the knowledge of millions of books and tomes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲ ਕੀ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਲਤ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: til kee atul sobhaa tulat na tulaadhaar paar kai apaar na ana(n)t a(n)t paae hai ||

en.bdb: Even a little glory (equivalent to a sesame seed) in respect of a Sikh, who has achieved union with the Guru's words, is beyond assessment and evaluation. That grandeur is infinite and limitless, and can never be weighed or assessed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਭਾਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਬਾਰੰਬਾਰ ਨ ਅਘਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੯॥
verses.translit_en: koTin koTaan cha(n)dhr bhaan jot ko udhot hot balihaar baara(n)baar na aghaae hai ||269||

en.bdb: As a result of the light effulgence in the Sikh of the Guru who has perpetually practiced in his mind the contemplation on the words of the Guru millions of Moons and Suns go sacrifice unto him again and again. (269)
